user_input:
Perform the user's selected FULL cleanup/rearchitecture of this repository, following PRODUCT_REQUIREMENTS_DOCUMENT_PRD.md and preserving all required product behavior. Current working tree is already dirty with substantial ongoing PostgreSQL migration changes and user-provided untracked PRD; inspect and preserve all existing edits. Do not revert unrelated/current changes, never delete PRODUCT_REQUIREMENTS_DOCUMENT_PRD.md or other user data, and do not run destructive migrations/seeds against any DB.

Bounded implementation objective:
1) Make the frontend map in the discovery page render a real readable online basemap without requiring a MapTiler API key; retain required attribution and the existing offline-pack capability/contracts. User screenshot showed uniform blue blank map. Source already has a recent local change defaulting MapView.tsx to OpenFreeMap Liberty and updating the empty-POI message to PostgreSQL; preserve these, verify/fix errors and runtime as appropriate.
2) Align the live runtime and repository organization with PRD domains (Visitor/POI/map/offline, Owner, Admin, Auth, Analytics, Audio), keeping routes/wire contracts stable. Remove MongoDB/Motor legacy source, dependencies, and tests only where no longer needed; preserve/rewrite useful regression coverage rather than deleting useful tests blindly. Update docs/build/test configs. Do not attempt to rebuild actual offline regional PMTiles from empty placeholders or remove PMTiles product requirement; clearly identify if actual tile data unavailable.
3) Do a complete, evidence-based check for MongoDB runtime/dependency references after changes and ensure PostgreSQL E2E config stays isolated and safe.

Validation: run targeted Python PostgreSQL tests, Ruff, frontend lint/tests/build. Avoid running DB-destructive seed/E2E commands on the live database. Report precise files changed, any remaining intentional legacy references/limits, and validation outcomes. Stop when those outcomes are met; do not make unrelated style/security fixes.

Classification: brownfield in-place upgrade/cleanup, preserve PostgreSQL migration already underway. Frontend and Python backend are in scope; detected languages Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, 16,295 LOC total, git repository, repo dirs backend/frontend/docs/scripts. Target is in-place; preserve existing requested stack and configuration. Feasibility: feasible; PostgreSQL migration and a keyless OpenFreeMap basemap are supported approaches. Scope is not a full frontend rewrite; only map behavior/configuration and project/runtime cleanup are requested. User explicitly requires stable routes/contracts, actual PMTiles data is unavailable from placeholders unless worker confirms otherwise, and no destructive DB operations.
title: PostgreSQL Runtime and Map Cleanup

assessment_snapshot.intro: The supplied repository facts and task brief identify a brownfield cleanup spanning the frontend and Python backend:
bullets: The task is explicitly in-place, with an ongoing PostgreSQL migration and dirty user changes to preserve.
The requested frontend change is limited to the discovery map; a keyless OpenFreeMap basemap and continued offline-pack contracts are required.
Routes and wire contracts must remain stable; regression coverage and PostgreSQL E2E isolation are required.
Detected languages are Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; PMTiles regional data may be unavailable because the current files are placeholders.

proposed_outcome: Keep the existing application stacks and in-place PostgreSQL migration, make the discovery map readable without a MapTiler key, and reorganize/clean up only within the stated PRD boundaries while preserving routes, product behavior, regression coverage, user edits, and safe database-operation constraints. Validate with the requested Python PostgreSQL tests, Ruff, and frontend lint/tests/build; document intentional legacy references and unavailable tile data.
